title: Spells After Dark
description: A woman in a long dark blue coat and white scarf stands at the entrance of a magical shop at night, reaching toward a glowing wreath on the wooden door. The storefront features a large display window filled with glowing blue potions, hourglasses, star charts, and nautical artifacts, beneath a sign reading 'LUMEN & VESSEL - SPELLS AFTER DARK'.
prompt: A woman in a long navy coat and cream scarf stands on a wet cobblestone street at night, decorating the door of a magical shop called Lumen & Vessel - Spells After Dark. The shop has an ornate wooden door with a glowing wreath and a large display window filled with glowing blue potions, hourglasses, star maps, and nautical symbols. An aurora borealis lights up the dark sky above gothic rooftops, a black cat sits by a box of void ink, magical lanterns illuminate the scene.
